# C — Godot C# procedural rifle mesh and scripts

**The owner's convention:** the **temporary low-poly rifle mesh must be generated by Godot C# code inside this `C/` folder**. Do not put the generated mesh code into `Artwork/`. A future imported art model will live separately in `../Artwork/`.

Planned code when authorized:
- `RifleMeshBuilder.cs`: procedural box/cylinder/custom mesh composition and shared material creation; produces child visuals beneath the rifle scene root.
- `RifleController.cs`: optional firing, cooldown, muzzle effect and simple hitscan; no mandatory idle loop.
- `RifleSettings.cs`: [GlobalClass] typed Resource exposing inspector options, read through `../Configuration/RifleMaster.tres`.

Keep scripts concise, with header comments, comments and `// =========================================================` separators above methods, and an independently replaceable visual root. **No C# code exists here yet.**
